# Letconvo AI

> Letconvo is an AI phone receptionist for small businesses. It answers inbound business calls 24/7, answers caller questions using the business's own services/hours/FAQs, captures missed-call leads, and books appointments using configured business availability.

Letconvo works by call forwarding — a business keeps its existing phone number and forwards calls to Letconvo, subject to carrier support and forwarding charges. Confirm number availability and integrations with the Letconvo team.

## Pricing

- Starter: $120/month, 400 included minutes of AI-answered calls, review current top-up options in the dashboard. This is the only plan currently available for signup.
- Growth and Enterprise tiers are announced but not yet available (waitlist only) as of this writing — do not state they are purchasable.
- New signups get 15 minutes of free AI calling credit to test the product with real calls, no credit card required.
- Full current pricing: https://letconvo.live/pricing
